description: Start a Feature's approved mission, show its plan, list the stories and Bugs that can start now, in order, or stop, resume, or end it.

action.description: start: a person starts the approved mission, through GitHub's device flow, and the plan records them, their tool for this repository, and the budget; refused for an agent lane. show: print the plan, each number with its source. next: list the mission's stories and Bugs that can start now, in order (priority, slice order, Ready time), and why each other one waits, with no model call; it claims each start on the ledger (missions/<f>/claims.jsonl), so two runs never start one story, and only the mission's recorded tool runs it. With --json it is an aayudha.work/v1 list: {schema, scope {kind, id}, items [{key, action, reason, subthread}]}. stop: a person stops the mission (or one story or Bug with --story), through GitHub's device flow and from any tool: mission next starts nothing and ship merges none of its PRs; each running Amp, Claude Code, or Cursor thread is told to commit at its next checkpoint and stop, and a thread aayu cannot reach is named; claims, branches, and PRs stay, and other missions and loops run on. resume: a person on the mission's recorded tool continues it (or one story with --story) and starts stories up to its agents. Each control is recorded in the plan's controls; both are refused for an agent lane.

end.description: With stop: end the mission, only by the person who started it. Merged stories stay merged; each open story and Bug loses its claims and goes back to status:ready, its open PRs close, the lock ends, and each locked issue gets one comment.

feature.description: Feature whose mission to start, show, list, stop, or resume.

reason.description: With stop: why, in one line; it is recorded and shown wherever the stop is.

story.description: With stop or resume: only this story or Bug of the mission; the rest runs on.

title: mission
